props.label: Standard Workcenters
props.description: The default number of workcenters on which to run this productStrategyProcess (REQUIRED, DEFAULT=1)

props.label: Cycle Time
props.description: Cycle time is measured in Seconds per Inventory Unit

props.label: Distribution Percentage
props.description:
The percentage of the Work Order Qty to be allocated to the primary workcenter. Total of all alternates and primary workcenters should not exceed 100%. 

(REQUIRED, Default 1 (100% for primary workcenter))

props.label: Ideal Rate
props.description: The Ideal Rate is used for indicating 100% run time, 100% quality what you would expect the workcenter to produce. This rate is used in OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Lead Time
props.description: Supplier lead time

props.label: Minimum Production Run Time
props.description: In hours the minimum amount of time a production run can be scheduled for.  (Ex: 8-hour job with 2-hour min will get up to 4 schedules with setup time per each if there is availability on a calendar)

props.label: Percent To Start
props.description: Required percent (of total quantity) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Production Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a production mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product/Workcenter Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Production Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.

props.label: Quantity To Start
props.description: Required quantity (in productStrategy.consumtionUnit) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Quoted Rate
props.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Setup Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a setup mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Setup Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.

props.label: Setup Rate
props.description: The amount of time setup takes.  This is always in terms of "Hours" .

props.label: Standard Rate
props.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Time To Start
props.description: Required time in seconds until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Unit Per Cycle
props.description: Quantity produced per cycle

props.label: Unit Weight
props.description: Weight per unit (DEFAULT = 0); This should be a float value - which references the weight UoM from the Strategy

props.label: Description
props.description: description

props.label: External Id
props.description: Links out to other system

props.label: Order
props.description: Order of process in Product Strategy (REQUIRED)

props.label: Custom Data
props.description: A place to store multiple attributes or pieces of custom data for the ProductStrategyProcess.

props.label: Process
props.description: Process object (REQUIRED)

props.label: Product Strategy
props.description: ProductStrategy object (REQUIRED)

props.label: Document Design (Label)
props.description: document object

props.label: Primary Put Away Location
props.description: PutAwayLocation object

props.label: Resource (Workcenter / Supplier)
props.description: Workcenter or Supplier who primarily performs this process.

props.label: Allow Mixed Lots
props.description: Identifies mixed lots (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Auto Trigger Dependency
props.description:
Automatically start/finish next/prev process.

SS - Auto start this process time/qty/percent after prev starts.

SF - Auto finish previous process after this process starts (assuming it is complete)

FS - Auto start this process after previous finishes

FF - Auto finish this process after previous finishes (assuming it is complete)

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Default Distribution
props.description: if default distribution = True, this strategy process will create a work order distribution record upon work order creation. when false - no distribution will be created for this WC but can be added to the WO manually after the fact (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

props.label: Final
props.description: Mark true, if this is the "Final" process for this product Strategy.

props.label: Finished Good
props.description: Finished Good indicates the end product (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Raw Material
props.description: Raw Material indicates whether the strategy process used raw material (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Transfer Serial
props.description: Processes with "Transfer Serial" attribute will advance inventory from either the prior process or a BOM component with consumption type "transfer serial". Processes with "Transfer Serial" must have a predecessor or a single item in BOM whose consumption is configured as "transfer serial"

props.label: Use Workcenter Rates
props.description: If useWorkcenterRates is set to true, the standard, setup, ideal, and quoted rates set on the workcenter will be used. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Wip
props.description: Work in progress (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)
